home_title.en: Go Redis Cache with Fallback | go-redis-fallback

en.home: Archived Go Redis cache library by Pardn Chiu (邱敬幃), final release v1.0.0: when Redis is down, reads and writes fall back to memory and local JSON.
en.getting-started: Install go-redis-fallback with go get, create the DBPath directory, start an instance, and confirm the current mode from its logs.
en.core-concepts: The three storage tiers and three operating modes of go-redis-fallback, and which tier Get, Set, and Del use in each mode.
en.architecture: One overview diagram of go-redis-fallback: read path, batch file writer, health-check ticker, recovery flow, and expiry sweep.
en.read-fallback: How Get reads memory first, retries Redis MaxRetry times, and switches to fallback mode within the same call when Redis fails.
en.read-fallback-local: How Get restores values from MD5-sharded local JSON files in fallback mode, and why restored numbers come back as float64.
en.read-repair: Why a normal-mode memory hit writes the value back to Redis in the background, and how it restores keys stored without a TTL.
en.read-expiry: How go-redis-fallback stores TTL in whole seconds, checks expiry on every read tier, and sweeps expired entries every 30 seconds.
en.recovery: What switches go-redis-fallback into fallback mode, how the TimeToCheck ping detects a recovered Redis, and startup recovery.
en.recovery-resync: How recovery loads local files, pipelines entries back to Redis with their remaining TTL in batches of 100, and deletes the files.
en.write-path: How Set and Del behave in normal and fallback modes, and how fallback writes merge by key in a queue and flush to disk in batches.
en.file-storage: Path rule and JSON format of go-redis-fallback local files: three-level MD5 sharding, Cache fields, and when files are deleted.
en.configuration: go-redis-fallback Config fields and defaults for Redis, Options, and Log, how invalid values are corrected, and tuning tips.
en.api-reference: Signatures, return values, errors, and panics of New, Get, Set, Del, and Close in go-redis-fallback.
en.api-reference-types: Every exported type in go-redis-fallback: Config, Redis, Options, Log, Cache, RedisFallback, and the internal Writer types.

zh.home: 邱敬幃開發的 Go Redis 快取斷線降級函式庫，已封存、最終版本 v1.0.0：Redis 斷線時讀寫改由記憶體與本地 JSON 接手，恢復後回灌。
zh.getting-started: 以 go get 安裝 go-redis-fallback、預先建立 DBPath 目錄、建立實例並從日誌確認目前運作模式。
zh.core-concepts: go-redis-fallback 的三層儲存與三種運作模式，以及 Get、Set、Del 在各模式下使用哪一層。
zh.architecture: go-redis-fallback 架構概覽：讀取路徑、批次寫檔、健康檢查 Ticker、恢復流程與過期掃除的關係。
zh.read-fallback: 正常模式下 Get 如何先查記憶體、重試 Redis，並在失敗時於同一次呼叫內切入 fallback 模式。
zh.read-fallback-local: Fallback 模式下 Get 如何從 MD5 分片的本地 JSON 檔還原資料，以及還原後的型別變化。
zh.read-repair: 正常模式記憶體命中時為何在背景寫回 Redis，以及它如何補回未設 TTL 的鍵。
zh.read-expiry: go-redis-fallback 如何以整數秒儲存 TTL、在每一層讀取時判斷過期，以及每 30 秒的過期掃除。
zh.recovery: 什麼情況會切入 fallback、健康檢查如何以 TimeToCheck 間隔偵測 Redis 恢復，以及啟動時的恢復。
zh.recovery-resync: 恢復時如何載入本地檔、以剩餘 TTL 每 100 筆 Pipeline 寫回 Redis 並刪除檔案，以及哪些資料不會寫回。
zh.write-path: Set 與 Del 在正常與 fallback 模式下的行為，以及 fallback 寫入如何經佇列合併後批次落檔。
zh.file-storage: go-redis-fallback 本地檔案的路徑規則與 JSON 格式：MD5 三層分片、Cache 欄位與檔案刪除時機。
zh.configuration: go-redis-fallback 的 Config 欄位與預設值：Redis、Options、Log，無效值修正方式與調整建議。
zh.api-reference: go-redis-fallback 的 New、Get、Set、Del、Close 簽章、回傳值、錯誤與 panic 條件。
zh.api-reference-types: go-redis-fallback 所有匯出型別：Config、Redis、Options、Log、Cache、RedisFallback 與內部型別。
